Yichun Qu received her B.S. in Electronic and Information Engineering from Xidian University in 2024 and her M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Brown University in 2026. She is currently a first year Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at NC State University. Her research interests include nonlinear control, safety-critical control, and reinforcement learning.
